open_questions.question: Default refresh reuse grace window (reuseGrace): 0 s vs a few seconds (00 §10 Q2). AC pins only the 0 s behaviour; 05 proposes default 0 with 'within grace: 401 only, no revocation'.
Derivation labels for the access-token and refresh-token keys are not given in 00 (only naru-device and naru-device-fp are). Choose labels at implementation and fix them in docs/api.
Verification of a token without kid when the key set has a single key: 01 §2.4 allows it, 00 R8 says always issue kid. Left out of the ACs.
Default HashCost when the app configures none, and whether calibrate(target) rejects targets outside 250-500 ms (R5 gives the range without saying how it is enforced).
Default PasswordPolicy minimum length (00 §10 Q1: 8 vs 15) and the HTTP status/error code for a policy violation (05 uses 422 WEAK_PASSWORD in upper case, conflicting with 00's lower-case code rule).
Retry-After value on slot backpressure 503 is not fixed by 00 (06 suggests 1 s).

Behaviour when an auth file exceeds the FILE limit: R43 says doctor WARN advising JDBC, but does not say whether reading fails above the cap or whether the WARN fires before reaching it. KB interpreted as KiB.
RefreshTokenStore method set and RefreshRecord fields are not tabled in 00 (05 §3.9 proposal used as advisory). revokeUser from 05 has no 00 counterpart (00 R1 uses ver++ for ?all=true).
Method shapes of the Authenticator SPI for Bearer and API key credentials are not given in 00; only the password seam is proposed in 05 §3.9.
KeySources.rotating(...) argument and file format, and the package of KeySources (utils.auth vs spi), are not fixed by 00.
